changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code IN ('collector_datasource', 'collector_table_resource', 'collector_api');

changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection' LIMIT 1), path = 'flow', component = 'etl/FlowManagement.vue', sort = 1 WHERE menu_code = 'etl:flow:list';

changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id = (SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code = 'data_collection' LIMIT 1), path = 'flow/monitor', component = 'etl/FlowMonitor.vue', sort = 2 WHERE menu_code = 'etl:flow:monitor';

changeSet.author: dabai
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sys_role_menu (role_id, menu_id) SELECT 1, id FROM sys_menu WHERE menu_code IN ('etl:flow:list', 'etl:flow:monitor') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = 1 AND menu_id = sys_menu.id);
